goal: Convert a curated personality frontier into a uniform N1 substrate without granting new epistemic or training authority.
procedure: Verify ZIP CRC and package SHA manifest. Normalize each active direct/inferred/synthetic record into a common schema while preserving original provenance, loss lanes, support IDs, uncertainty, relationship/context fields, runtime-vs-history flags, and owner-review state. Validate every E0 support reference and forbid identity-support overlap with context-only/excluded support. Keep historical unknowns separate. Preserve alternative competitors as unordered and refuse to convert them into hard negatives unless separately authorized. Build support edges, an observed concept inventory, and deterministic family-aware train/dev/test partitions. Emit a receipt that remains private-gradient unauthorized.
constraints: synthetic behavior is not historical truth or lived memory
unknown remains a valid epistemic outcome
alternative competitors are not automatic negatives
no private payload is committed to the public branch
decision_criteria: all E0 identity/context/excluded support IDs resolve
manifest counts agree with observed rows
authority: Compilation only. It does not authorize private gradients, promote hypotheses to direct evidence, or authorize alternatives as negatives.
validation: Executed against the actual private curated v2 package. 34 internally manifested files verified; active records=2460 (E0=290, E-INF=205, A-SYN=1965); train/dev/test=2226/118/116; support edges=12968; historical UNKNOWN=3496; unordered alternatives=13719; active training-authority true rows=0; owner-final-review-required rows=2460.
failure_or_lesson: A consumer builder should treat provenance and authority as data carried through compilation, not as labels reconstructed after training. Compilation should fail closed when support, counts, or authority flags disagree.
notes: No private source text was written to the public FBM branch.
